picks.why: Slimmest star with a modest gem and restrained shading. 1 and 2 run heavier, with an oversized gem, the bright, chunky direction the lessons flag as generated.
True horseshoe taper with heels narrowing inward and a simple soft form. 1 has oversized heel blocks and 2 is squat, wide and over-grooved.
Slim body with ten small holes and small end caps gives true harmonica proportions. 2 is stubby with seven toy-sized holes, and 1 has a thicker body and bigger holes.
Tapered enamel body reads instantly as a cowboy coffee pot. 2 is a round teapot, so it is the wrong object.
Consistent perspective, believable upright proportions and a clear keyboard. 1 has a skewed, overhanging top and 3 adds a brass strip with a narrower keyboard.
Thinner, twiggier branches with broken ends read as dry tumbleweed. 2 has thick smooth strands that read as a wicker or yarn ball. Both have an invented sprig, and 1 is the less distracting.
Balanced tub-to-wheel ratio, a modest gold pile and a plausible end handle. 1 has a chunky body and a handle hanging oddly off the undercarriage, and 2 is squatter with a clumsy handle.
Clean thin borders and a tight natural fan with every suit legible. 2 has puffy toy-like edges, and 1 has oversized clipped pips that clutter the fan.
Instantly a saloon, with arched false front, batwing doors and balcony, solid proportions and no added ornament. 3 invents a star and scrolls, and 2 is lopsided and plainer.
Best rotor-to-tower ratio with a slender tapering lattice and restrained detail. 1 is chunky and top-heavy, and 2 has an odd central front post.
